{{Quote|Your target is Brall Tavar. He's Czerka Corellia's figurehead, the definition of corporate sleaze|Commander Jastal briefs an Imperial-aligned individual|<ref name="Czerka" />}}
'''Jastal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial Guard]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. At the [[Battle of Corellia]], Jastal was tasked by [[Darth Charnus]] to retrieve the [[Hull-cracker|Hull Cracker]] weapon from the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. Jastal helped an Imperial-aligned individual complete the mission by directing him to [[Brall Tavar]], Czerka [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] figurehead who had the weapon's activation codes, while Jastal and his men retrieved the Hull Cracker itself.<ref name="Czerka" />
